pages.text: Speed Upgrade Module: mining efficiency takes off — and so does the power bill.$(br)Each block adds +12.5% rate and +10% energy cost, $(2,4)up to 10 blocks$(0). Right-click to install onto the structure's upgrade-frame slots; it runs like a cheat code.
Fortune Upgrade Module: makes your mineral yield fatter.$(br)Each block adds +1 to a single drop, $(2,4)up to 4 blocks$(0). Once installed, every swing is "the joy of harvest".

Storage Upgrade Module: expands the miner's "belly".$(br)Each block adds +50% energy capacity, $(2,4)up to 10 blocks$(0).$(br2)Modules can be swapped or removed right on the upgrade-frame slots; the controller re-sums every 20 ticks. Add them anytime — the miner never sleeps.
